title: What Is Treated as Withheld When Money Is Returned on Car Hire
content:
Two things decide what is treated as withheld when money is returned on a rental booked under the
Car Rental Rate Classes: the supplier's messages standing on that rental, and whether the vehicle was ever
collected.

| What the rental's records show | Treated as withheld |
| --- | --- |
| a notice stands on the rental that the supplier cannot provide the vehicle | nothing |
| the vehicle was never collected | only the charge the ledger carries for the rental being given up |
| neither of the above | the whole of the money settled in advance |

Where a notice stands on the rental that the supplier cannot provide the vehicle, nothing is treated as
withheld. Where the vehicle was never collected, only the charge the ledger carries for the rental being
given up is treated as withheld. Where neither holds, the whole of the money settled in advance is treated
as withheld.

## Order of the rows

The rows are taken in the order they stand. A rental that carries such a notice and on which the vehicle was
also never collected is answered by the first row, and nothing is treated as withheld.

A vehicle that was never collected is one on which no collection stands recorded against the rental. Where
the rental records show the vehicle was collected and no such notice stands, the third row answers.

## One rental in three situations

A rental carrying 500 USD of advance payments, on which the vehicle was never collected and whose ledger
carries a charge of 120 USD for the rental being given up: 120 USD is treated as withheld. The same rental
with a notice standing that the supplier could not provide the vehicle: nothing is treated as withheld. The
same rental with the vehicle collected and no such notice: 500 USD is treated as withheld.
